mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% monthly increase in INDPRO, signaling a supply chain rebound, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO-S&P 500 relationship falls below 0.01 in post-shock recovery regimes.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $450,000, indicating strong housing demand, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, particularly in early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX returns are insignificantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.10) during expansions with strong RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 220) indicates an impending monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant difference in SPX returns between triggered and non-triggered periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth rate positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting the labor market's influence on short-term market sentiment.
failure_condition: PAYEMS-S&P 500 correlation coefficient falls below 0.10 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 900,000 units, signaling robust housing demand, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in regimes with low UNRATE (below 6%).
failure_condition: SPX returns during triggered low-unemployment expansions are not significantly higher than in non-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).
